Editorial 'For Connally, Smith and Carr' — Smith 'served six years in the House (1944-1950) and six years in the State Senate (1956-1962)'; only candidate qualified by experience.

Editorial 'Connally, Smith, Carr, Langdon Due Reelection' — 'John Connally has made a good governor' with 'foresight, vision, a depth of perception for problems and with a quality of leadership that have set him apart.'

Editorial 'Cong. Omar Burleson' — 'Since 1947 Omar Burleson of Anson has represented the 17th District in Congress.' Seeking 10th term. 'Rep. Burleson is high in seniority in the House, and serves as chairman of the Administration Committee and a member of the Foreign Affairs Committee. The Reporter-News urges his reelection.'

Editorial 'Connally, Smith, Carr, Langdon Due Reelection' — 'Preston Smith and Waggoner Carr not only have compiled excellent records of their own, but they compose an effective team with Connally that has given our state government an unusual degree of leadership.'

Editorial 'Presidency in Good Hands With Johnson' — Johnson 'has been President of the United States for almost 11 months. He has been a good one. He should be continued.' Praises prosperity, civil rights law, and judgment vs. Goldwater.

Editorial 'Connally, Smith, Carr, Langdon Due Reelection' — Jim Langdon, West Texan, district judge, then El Paso Civil Appeals Court, named railroad commissioner by Connally; running for reelection in his own right. Has hearty support of leaders of oil and transportation industries.

Editorial 'For Grant Jones' — supports Grant Jones for office of 84th District Representative, Place 2, in next Tuesday's election. 'A mature man with a record of success and sound judgment in business life as well as community life.' Place 2 Taylor County (paired with Raleigh Brown, Place 1)

Editorial 'Sen. David Ratliff' — 'The Reporter-News urges his reelection next Tuesday. He is the incumbent Democratic candidate.' Praises 14 years experience and water legislation including West Central Texas Municipal Water District.
Editorial '4 Candidates Endorsed' — 'Crawford Martin deserves a second term as Attorney General.' Has performed efficiently and responsibly.
Editorial '4 Candidates Endorsed' — 'Preston Smith has the ideal credentials for Governor.' 18 years in state government as State Rep, State Senator, and Lt Governor.

Editorial '4 Candidates Endorsed' — 'Ben Barnes has spent eight years in the House of Representatives, four of them (two terms) as its Speaker. This ideally qualifies him to move up to Lieutenant Governor.'

Editorial 'Vote for Humphrey, For Your World Depends on It' — coined 'Nixon, but to Humphrey.' Today endorses Humphrey for President. Praises pride and conviction; backed by Eisenhower (Democratic Party) and Johnson administration.

Editorial '4 Candidates Endorsed' — 'Jim Langdon, first appointed to the Railroad Commission five years ago, brings a good background as judge and lawyer to direction of the Railroad Commission. Certainly he merits reelection.'

Editorial 'Vote for Humphrey, For Your World Depends on It' — 'We can imagine Muskie as President. If fate so dictates, we cannot say the same for Gov. Spiro Agnew, whose choice by Richard Nixon we can ascribe only to political expediency.'
